tinker.name: Calculation Pad
tinker.description: Notepad-style calculator for evaluating expressions line by line

zh-CN.name: 计算稿纸
zh-CN.description: 记事本风格计算器，逐行计算数学表达式

calculate.description: Evaluate one or more math expressions on the calculation pad. Separate multiple expressions with newlines. Replaces the current pad content, updates the UI, and returns each expression with its result.

expression.description: Math expression, or multiple expressions separated by newlines

get.description: Get the current expressions and results on the calculation pad.

clear.description: Clear all expressions on the calculation pad.
